ns2:course.label: Air Quality Modeling
ns2:course.description: Practical and advanced approaches to air pollution modeling, including aspects of pollutant transport, transformation, and loss. Gaussian plume, chemical mass balance, chemical reaction, grid and trajectory models. Evaluation of models and the development of efficient control strategies. Same as ATMS 425. Prerequisite: CEE 330 and credit or concurrent registration in TAM 335; or ATMS 302.
